info.name: Member Posts Management
info.description:
Standalone collection covering lms-external-api-frontend APIs gated by (or relevant to) the `r_member_social` (read) and `w_member_social` (write/create) permissions, based on direct code inspection.

**r_member_social folder**: code-verified read/finder requests (Posts, Member Event Subscriptions) plus read requests for Comments/Reactions/Social Actions/Social Metadata/Documents/Videos/Images/Video Analytics that are NOT independently code-verified for this permission (see per-request descriptions and the note below).

**w_member_social folder**: CREATE-only requests (no update/delete) to seed sample member-owned data -- Posts, Comments, Reactions, Documents (initializeUpload + publish), Videos (initializeUpload + finalizeUpload), and Images (initializeUpload). Member Event Subscriptions, Social Actions, Social Metadata, and Video Analytics have no create/write endpoint and so have no w_member_social counterpart.

CORRECTION NOTE: A direct code search across CommentsService, LikesService (Reactions), SocialActionsService, SocialMetadataService, DocumentsService, VideosService, ImagesService, VideoAnalyticsService, and MemberCreatorVideoAnalyticsService found no explicit r_member_social read-permission checks -- only w_member_social appears, and only on create/actor-validation paths (Reactions/Documents/Videos/Images). Per the code comment in PartnerPushEventSubscriptionKeySchemaValidator.java, permission-to-endpoint mappings for many partner APIs are 'derived from file based configuration in externalized-api-configs MP', a separate repo not checked out locally, so gateway-level read-scope enforcement for those 8 resources can't be verified from this codebase alone.

Use together with the existing **community-management-env-versioning** environment.

--All requests are in the Restli 2.0 format--

request.description: GET a post authored by a member (person URN). PostsClient.get() calls getPartnerAccessRestrictionsToPass(), which checks r_member_social to determine whether member-only partner access restrictions can be relaxed for the caller. See PostsClient.java / PostsService.java.
BATCH_GET posts authored by members. Same r_member_social-gated partner access restriction logic as the single GET. See PostsClient.batchGet().

FINDER 'author'. PostsService.validateAuthorUrnType() explicitly requires r_member_social (read case) whenever the author URN is a person URN. Returns 400 'Member permissions must be used when using member as author' if r_member_social is missing. See PostsService.java findByAuthor()/validateAuthorUrnType().

item.name: Create/Upsert a Member Social Action Subscription

request.description: UPDATE (upsert, no server-generated id) a webhook subscription for MEMBER_SOCIAL_ACTION_NOTIFICATION events on a consented member. PartnerPushEventSubscriptionKeySchemaValidator requires r_member_social for this eventType and restricts entity/user to PersonUrn. See MemberEventSubscriptionResource.update().

item.name: Get a Member Social Action Subscription

request.description: GET the subscription record by its composite key. Requires r_member_social for the MEMBER_SOCIAL_ACTION_NOTIFICATION eventType. See MemberEventSubscriptionResource.get().

item.name: Find Subscriptions by Subscriber and Event Type

request.description: FINDER 'subscriberAndEventType'. Subscriber (developer application) and user are derived from the request context, not passed explicitly. Requires r_member_social for this eventType. See MemberEventSubscriptionResource.findBySubscriberAndEventType().

item.name: Delete a Member Social Action Subscription

request.description: DELETE the subscription record by its composite key. Requires r_member_social for the MEMBER_SOCIAL_ACTION_NOTIFICATION eventType. See MemberEventSubscriptionResource.delete().
Get a single comment. CommentsService has no permission checks in code; see collection description.

item.name: Member Creator Video Analytics - Find by Entity

request.description: FINDER entity (memberanalytics.MemberCreatorVideoAnalyticsResource.findByEntity), scoped to a member creator. MemberCreatorVideoAnalyticsService has no permission checks in code.

Creates a text post authored by a member (person URN). PostsService.validateAuthorUrnType() requires w_member_social when the author is a person URN (writeCase=true). See PostsClient.java / PostsService.java.

Creates a top-level comment as a member actor, to seed sample comment data for the Comments (read) requests. CommentsResource is CreateOnly on 'actor'; no explicit permission check found in CommentsService code, included here for parity with the w_member_social write-actions.

Creates a reaction (like) on a share as a member actor, to seed sample reaction data. LikesService.validateActorUrnType() requires w_member_social (or w_member_social_feed) when actor is a person URN.

Initializes a document upload owned by a member. DocumentsService.validateOwnerTypeBasedOnPermissions() requires w_member_social when owner is a person URN. Returns an uploadUrl + document URN used to seed sample document content.
